title: fix(build): replace dynamic require() with static imports in plugin-view
body:
CI build fails on two issues: Turbopack rejects module-level `require('@object-ui/react')` during SSR prerendering of `/docs/components/complex/view-switcher`, and TS6133 on unused `...rest` in `ObjectCalendar`.

- **`plugin-view/src/index.tsx` & `ObjectView.tsx`**: Replace `try { require('@object-ui/react') } catch {}` with static imports. `@object-ui/react` is already a declared dependency and statically imported elsewhere in the package (`ViewSwitcher.tsx`), so the dynamic require was unnecessary.

```diff
-const mod = require('@object-ui/react');
-SchemaRendererComponent = mod.SchemaRenderer || null;
+import { SchemaRenderer as ImportedSchemaRenderer } from '@object-ui/react';
+const SchemaRendererComponent: React.FC<any> = ImportedSchemaRenderer;
```

- **`plugin-calendar/src/ObjectCalendar.tsx`**: Remove unused `...rest` destructured prop (TS6133).
